name: Meshulam Levinstein Contracting & Engineering Ltd.
summary: Meshulam Levinstein Contracting & Engineering Ltd. engages in engineering, construction, and real estate businesses in Israel and internationally. The company undertakes development and execution of construction projects for residential, office, and commercial and industrial purposes. It also develops office buildings, public buildings, and structures designed for the hi-tech industry; housing units, apartment buildings, and residential neighborhoods; and shopping centers and commercial buildings.
